title: Roadmap Dependency Gateway and Exception Flow
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design and implement a centralized 'Dependency Gateway' for roadmap items that standardizes intake, routing, SLA enforcement, and an exception flow for blocked or high-risk dependencies. The gateway will: 1) require structured metadata on every cross-team dependency; 2) auto-route to owners (eng/design/security/infra) with SLA timers; 3) provide an exception/escalation workflow that surfaces blockers to leadership and proposes contingency actions; and 4) feed a lightweight simulation model showing potential OKR and milestone slip risk. Goal: reduce untracked late surprises in quarterly roadmaps, make cross-team commitments visible, and shorten time-to-resolution for blocking items.
acceptance_criteria: Dependency intake form with required fields (owner, scope, type, risk, estimated work, blockers) and validation rules implemented in Linear or embedded UI
Auto-routing rules that assign to target team leads or rotation owners with configurable SLA timers and reminder cadence
Exception flow: when SLA breaches or blocker flagged, create an escalation path (owner -> PM -> Eng Director -> COO) with automated notifications and suggested mitigations
Simulation UI that can run a 'what-if' on active dependencies to estimate milestone slippage and OKR confidence impact (visualization + CSV export)
Audit log and metrics: dependency lifecycle events, time-to-resolve, and dashboard populated in Console for per-initiative views
updates: 2026-02-20 - Created ticket and initial problem statement. Noted recurring issue: late discovery of infra/security blockers during canary windows for Dedicated deployments.

2026-02-24 - PM sync with Eng infra (Ravi) and Design (Maya Zhou) to capture existing intake patterns. Agreed to standardize on 8 required fields for intake. Action: ENG to prototype webhook to Linear -> Console (ENG-1842).

2026-03-01 - Spike complete: prototype Linear form + serverless router accepts dependency submissions and posts assignment to Slack channel #dep-triage. Found trade-off: too many notifications if timers short; agreed default SLA = 5 business days adjustable per priority.

2026-03-04 - Design review: wireframes for Dependency Gateway UI and exception modal. Feedback: add 'rollback/contingency' checklist and link to runbooks. Design PRD: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/dep-gateway-prd (internal).

2026-03-08 - Security flagged need for KMS audit link on Private deployments when dependency includes encryption changes. Decided to require a 'security impact' field and label to kick off a light security review. Security contact: Priya Singh.

2026-03-10 - Engineering prototype PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/9374 - implements intake webhook, SLA timers, and a basic escalation email. Running test on staging with 12 seeded dependencies.
2026-03-12 - PM/Design review: acceptance criteria refined to include simulation export. Added release target console-2026.04. Noted dependency on ENG-5021 for simulation model infra.
risks_and_tradeoffs: Notification fatigue vs. SLA sensitivity: shorter SLAs drive faster resolution but increase false escalations. We will implement adaptive backoff and summary digests.
Simulation accuracy: early model will be heuristic-based (severity buckets) and not a perfect predictor; communicate confidence bands in UI.
Cross-team adoption: must integrate into existing team rituals (e.g., weekly triage) to avoid abandonment. Plan to onboard via squad champions and rollout playbook.
next_steps: Complete integration of simulation microservice (ENG-5021) and wire it to staging data by 2026-03-20
Finalize Linear intake schema and push to all PMs; create an automation for existing open dependencies to be migrated by end of cycle
Implement exception modal with escalation templates and contingency checklists (Design + Eng collaboration)
Run a pilot with Platform, Dedicated, and Console teams for one sprint and capture metrics (time-to-acknowledge, time-to-resolve, false-escalation rate)
Prepare rollout notes and training session for Q2 PM cadence; link to playbook in Confluence
